name: Mathis Claude
source:
[i]"That monster... I want to kill that monster with my own hands...!"[/i]

[i]Spurning his fate to forgive.[/i]

A young man who lives in Chedis. He loves reading, and his room is always filled with books. As he is extremely timid and shy, he struggles with eye contact and conversations with others. His brother was killed by "Bourreau," so he is searching for the killer in order to mete out vengeance.

[b]Occupation:[/b] Head of the Claude Family

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/vircheevermore/characters/]Aksys Games[/url]]
